description_en: Queries the list and basic information of all team shared drives in an enterprise cloud drive
description_zh: 查询企业网盘内所有团队共享盘的列表及基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-cloud-drive-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-shanghai+cds-1355150000 --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --group-name '测试团队1' --parent-group-id cg-e70ga4ixp30ur0000 --drive-status enabled --group-type org --drive-type binding --directory-id cn-hangzhou+dir-jedbpr4sl9l370000 --directory-name testDirectoryName --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6lY3I2VNHLwy+nIoSXh0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudDriveGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of team space IDs
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The team space name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 团队空间名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent node of the object to query. To query the root node, set this parameter to `root`.

Default value: empty, which indicates that all team spaces are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询对象的父节点ID。查询根节点时，填`root`。

默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: parent_group_id

parameters.help_en: The team type. Default value: empty, which indicates that all types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 团队类型。默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether a space is added. Default value: empty, which indicates that all types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 是否添加空间。默认为空，表示查询全部
parameters.name: drive_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

最大值：100
默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` that was returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token
